1711.11397v2.title: Predicting the hypervelocity star population in Gaia

evidence.quote:
In this section we assess the performance of Gaia in measuring
the astrometric properties of the current observed sample of HVS
candidates. Brown et al. (2015) measured proper motions with the
Hubble Space Telescope (HST) for 16 extreme radial velocity can-
didates, finding that 13 of them have trajectories consistent with a
GC origin within 2σ confidence levels, and 12 of them are unbound
to the Milky Way.
